newsitem.title: CANADA: Noranda denies zinc smelter rumors.
newsitem.headline: Noranda denies zinc smelter rumors.

text.p: Noranda Inc denied rumors on Friday of production problems at its zinc smelter in Valleyfield, Quebec.
"The plant is processing normally," Noranda spokesman Gilles Gratton said in an interview. "Everything is running fine."
The plant had "some normal glitches" a few weeks ago, but nothing serious enough to affect output, he said.
The mining company said last month it would lose 40,000 tonnes of contained zinc metal in concentrates this year because of production problems at its mine in New Brunswick.
But the cut will not affect output from the Valleyfield smelter, Gratton said.
Noranda produces about 480,000 dry tonnes of zinc every year.
